sentences.sentence: People laud the corporate hero -- the person going above and beyond -- but not corporate martyrs, who have killed themselves and potentially put the business in a compromised situation.

sentences.sentence: Once in the city, they even conducted obsequies for Him.
sentences.translation: 一旦在城市，他们甚至进行了葬礼他。

sentences.sentence: On that soldier's obsequies the general award his wife a medal and a American flag.
sentences.translation: 在那位士兵的葬礼上，将军授予士兵的妻子一枚勋章和一面美国国旗。

translations.translation: 造船工人, 造船木匠

sentences.sentence: What is he that builds stronger than either the mason, the shipwright, or the carpenter?

sentences.sentence: For if our heart reprehend us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
sentences.translation: 纵然我们的心责备我们，我们还可以安心，因为天主比我们的心大，他原知道一切。

sentences.sentence: The onus is on companies and consumers to keep up with anti-virus updates.
sentences.translation: 公司和用户有责任跟上杀毒软件的更新。

sentences.sentence: However, it is more interesting and fun studying with digital textbooks, which has augmentation contents and videos.
sentences.translation: 然而，电子教科书增加了内容和视频，用它来学习更令人感兴趣也更有乐趣。

sentences.sentence: That assessment prompted a rapid and massive augmentation of support in the form of international teams of specialized staff, presently in Uige and Luanda, and several shipments of supplies.
sentences.translation: 该评估促使以目前在威热和罗安达的国际专科工作人员小组的形式迅速大量增加支持，并且已几次发运用品。

sentences.sentence: The average yearly increment in productivity was 4.5 per cent.
sentences.translation: 生产率的年平均增长量是4.5%。

phrases.translation: 对比增强；增衬器；对比强化

sentences.sentence: Progressive enhancement helps us to do that because it forces us to focus on the content and build out from there.
sentences.translation: 渐进增强能够帮助我们做到这一点，因为它让我们关注内容并且从内容开始构建。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 285 单元

respite
音标：英 /'respaɪt; -spɪt/  美 /'rɛspɪt/
n. 暂缓
例句：a brief respite from persecution
暂时停止迫害

abeyance
音标：英 /ə'beɪəns/  美 /ə'beəns/
n. 暂时无效, 中止, 归属待定
短语：in abeyance — 归属待定；悬而未决，犹未定夺

assent
音标：英 /ə'sent/  美 /ə'sɛnt/
n. 赞成
短语：royal assent — （国王对国会决议的）御准
例句：a nod of assent
首肯

eulogy
音标：英 /'juːlədʒɪ/  美 /'jʊlədʒi/
n. 赞词, 颂词, 歌功颂德的话
例句：The minister delivered a long eulogy.
部长致长篇悼词。

encomium
音标：英 /en'kəʊmɪəm/  美 /ɛn'komɪəm/
n. 赞辞, 赞美, 称赞

laud
音标：英 /lɔːd/  美 /lɔd/
n. 赞美, 称赞, 颂歌
例句：And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
又说，外邦阿，你们当赞美主。万民哪，你们都当颂赞他。
例句：People laud the corporate hero -- the person going above and beyond -- but not corporate martyrs, who have killed themselves and potentially put the business in a compromised situation.
人们会称赞公司的英雄-那个很厉害的人，但是不会称赞公司的殉难者，那些不仅让自己壮烈牺牲还给公司带来潜在性伤害的人。

accolade
音标：英 /'ækəleɪd; ,ækə'leɪd/  美 /'ækəled/
n. 赞美, 骑士爵位的授予, 连谱号

hymn
音标：英 /hɪm/  美 /hɪm/
n. 赞美诗, 圣歌
例句：He liked to sing hymns as he worked.
他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

motet
音标：英 /məʊ'tet/  美 /mo'tɛt/
n. 赞美诗, 圣歌, 赞歌

obsequies
音标：英 /'ɒbsɪkwɪz/  美 /'ɑbsəkwɪz/
n. 葬礼
例句：Hundreds paid their last respects at his obsequies.
数百支付其最后的敬意在他的葬礼。
例句：Once in the city, they even conducted obsequies for Him.
一旦在城市，他们甚至进行了葬礼他。
例句：On that soldier's obsequies the general award his wife a medal and a American flag.
在那位士兵的葬礼上，将军授予士兵的妻子一枚勋章和一面美国国旗。

wreckage
音标：英 /'rekɪdʒ/  美 /'rɛkɪdʒ/
n. 遭难

shipwright
音标：英 /'ʃɪpraɪt/  美 /'ʃɪp,raɪt/
n. 造船工人, 造船木匠
例句：What is he that builds stronger than either the mason, the shipwright, or the carpenter?
能比石匠、船匠和木匠建造出更坚固的建筑的人，他是谁？

reprehend
音标：英 /,reprɪ'hend/  美 /,repri'hend/
n. 责备
例句：For if our heart reprehend us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
纵然我们的心责备我们，我们还可以安心，因为天主比我们的心大，他原知道一切。

stricture
音标：英 /'strɪktʃə/  美 /'strɪktʃɚ/
n. 责难

onus
音标：英 /'əʊnəs/  美 /'onəs/
n. 责任, 负担
短语：onus probandi — （拉）举证责任
短语：onus of proof — 举证责任
例句：The onus is on companies and consumers to keep up with anti-virus updates.
公司和用户有责任跟上杀毒软件的更新。

liability
音标：英 /laɪə'bɪlɪtɪ/  美 /'laɪə'bɪləti/
n. 责任, 义务, 倾向, 债务, 负债, 与assets相对
短语：liability company — 有限公司
短语：limited liability — 有限责任；有限债务责任
短语：limited liability company — 股份有限公司
短语：civil liability — 民事责任
短语：liability insurance — 责任保险（指保险公司负责被保险人依法对他人承担赔偿责任的保险）
短语：legal liability — 法律责任
短语：product liability — 产品责任
短语：criminal liability — 刑事责任
短语：tort liability — [法律]侵权行为赔偿责任
短语：limitation of liability — 责任范围
短语：strict liability — 严格责任；严格赔偿责任
短语：fault liability — [法]过失责任
短语：joint liability — 连带责任
短语：tax liability — 纳税义务
短语：several liability — 连带责任；个别责任
短语：joint and several liability — 连带责任
短语：liability without fault — 无过失责任
短语：product liability insurance — 产品责任保险
短语：products liability — 产品质量责任
短语：vicarious liability — 替代责任；转承债务
例句：The company had assets of $138 million and liabilities of $120.5 million.
该公司有1.38亿美元资产和1.205亿美元的负债。

incumbency
音标：英 /ɪn'kʌmb(ə)nsɪ/
n. 责任, 义务, 任职, 压

augmentation
音标：英 /ɔːgmen'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɔgmɛn'teʃən/
n. 增加
短语：augmentation mammaplasty — 假体隆胸术；丰胸手术
例句：However, it is more interesting and fun studying with digital textbooks, which has augmentation contents and videos.
然而，电子教科书增加了内容和视频，用它来学习更令人感兴趣也更有乐趣。
例句：That assessment prompted a rapid and massive augmentation of support in the form of international teams of specialized staff, presently in Uige and Luanda, and several shipments of supplies.
该评估促使以目前在威热和罗安达的国际专科工作人员小组的形式迅速大量增加支持，并且已几次发运用品。

increment
音标：英 /'ɪŋkrɪm(ə)nt/  美 /'ɪŋkrəmənt/
n. 增加, 增量
短语：temperature increment — 温度增量，温度升高值
短语：rate of increment — 增长率
短语：load increment — 载重增加；载荷增量
短语：time increment — 时间增量
例句：The average yearly increment in productivity was 4.5 per cent.
生产率的年平均增长量是4.5%。

enhancement
音标：英 /ɪn'hɑːnsm(ə)nt; en-/  美 /in'hænsmənt/
n. 增进, 增加
短语：image enhancement — 图象增强
短语：contrast enhancement — 对比增强；增衬器；对比强化
短语：enhancement effect — 增感效应
短语：precipitation enhancement — 人工增雨；降水增加
短语：enhancement technique — 增强技术
例句：Progressive enhancement helps us to do that because it forces us to focus on the content and build out from there.
渐进增强能够帮助我们做到这一点，因为它让我们关注内容并且从内容开始构建。
